messages:
ana: Weekly GPU capacity check — quick readout. EU-west had NIC flaps overnight (eu-west-1-cluster-b), APAC spot preemptions up ~20%. Promo Wed–Thu expected to add ~1.2M tokens/hr (~+12% load). Need a short plan: reserved vs shift, micro-batching rollouts, and any network mitigations.

mike: Can you list which clusters saw the NIC issues and time windows?

ana: eu-west-1-cluster-b: 03:40–04:10 UTC yesterday, 3 NIC resets. Packet loss spike ~0.8%. `dmesg | grep mlx5` shows driver resets. Ops ticket #8765 opened.

devon: Ops applied the kernel patch on cluster-b around 05:00 UTC, monitoring now. APAC preemptions seem tied to maintenance + customer test beds.

sarah: Promo load profile from growth: ~80% inference, 20% embeddings. Embeddings are latency-sensitive for ranking flows — we should avoid routing them cross-region if possible.

mike: Proposal: spin up 6 reserved GPUs in eu-west-1-cluster-c and migrate 4 embedding-only nodes there overnight. Buys runway and keeps embeddings local.

ana: Cost impact: ~ $6k/week for the extra reserved capacity. Alternate is routing overflow to US-west but that adds ~60ms RTT for EU clients.

lee: US-west headroom exists but RTT increase will inflate p50 by ~60ms — OK for chat but risky for embeddings in pipelines.

devon: Another lever: enable micro-batching on canary (eu-east-canary). In our load tests micro-batching reduced GPU-seconds per request by ~18% and lowered tail variance. Could roll to 10% then 50% if stable.

capacity-bot: ALERT: EU reserved utilization = 91%. Predicted burnrate during promo = 103% over 12h window.

sarah: Decision suggestion: mixed approach — provision 4 reserved GPUs in eu-west-1-cluster-c (instead of 6) + enable micro-batching rollout to 10% traffic starting Tue 22:00 UTC. Re-evaluate Wed 08:00 UTC. Any objections? :eyes:

mike: +1

devon: +1 — will prep canary rollout scripts and smoke tests.

ana: I'll open spend approval for the $4k delta (updated) and notify support/solutions teams about possible blips. Also will attach Ops ticket #8765 updates.

lee: I'll update routing policy to prefer eu-west-1-cluster-c for embedding routes and set fallback to US-west only if embedding latency > 120ms.

sarah: Follow-ups assigned: ana (spend approval + notify), devon (canary rollout + tests), lee (routing change), mike (monitor dashboards & alerts). Please call out any blockers here.

mike: Watching dashboards. Will escalate if 5xx rate > 0.5% or latency SLOs break.

ana: Thanks — will post a short runbook update in #eng-infra and schedule a quick sync Wed 08:00 UTC to confirm. /cc @channel
